description: Staff-side loader fix + auth/session robustness. Make the staff order status change optimistic (app/admin/order/[id].tsx) so the status buttons never hang — this is the real 'staff order delete loader' surface, since the mobile app has NO order-delete feature anywhere (verified). Then audit src/api.ts + src/store/auth.ts to guarantee the 401 path refreshes once, never loops, and always resolves to data/empty/error (never an unresolved spinner), WITHOUT weakening security. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: In app/admin/order/[id].tsx setStatus(status): make it optimistic. Before the network, snapshot const prevOrder = qc.getQueryData(['order', o.order_id]); const prevAll = qc.getQueryData(['all-orders']); then qc.setQueryData(['order', o.order_id], (old) => old ? { ...old, order_status: status } : old) and qc.setQueryData(['all-orders'], (list) => Array.isArray(list) ? list.map(x => x.order_id === o.order_id ? { ...x, order_status: status } : x) : list). Clear `saving` promptly (do not hold the button spinner across the network). Call api.post('/admin/orders/status', { orderId: o.order_id, status }) in the background; on success invalidate ['order', o.order_id] and ['all-orders'] as today; on failure restore prevOrder/prevAll via qc.setQueryData and show the existing error toast (showToast(apiError(e),'error')).

Add a short comment in setStatus noting that status change (incl. 'Cancelled') is the staff loader surface the user reported as 'order staff ke delete pe loader' — there is no DELETE endpoint in the mobile app.

Audit src/api.ts: confirm a 401 on a non-auth call triggers exactly ONE refreshSession()+retry (opts._retried guard) and cannot loop; confirm isAuthCall excludes /users/login,/users/refresh,/users/register from the retry; confirm the single-flight `refreshing` promise prevents a refresh storm; confirm a failed refresh causes the original request to throw an ApiError (not hang). Add a brief comment documenting the bounded path. Do NOT add an AbortController/15s timeout or a setOnSessionExpired hook that the codebase does not define. Change behavior ONLY if a genuine loop/hang is found.

Audit src/store/auth.ts: confirm logout is local-first (clears refresh token + access token + user even if the network logout fails) and that bootstrap()/reloadSession() set ready and never leave the app on the splash loader when refresh fails. Change ONLY if a real gap exists; otherwise document that the existing OfflineGate + per-screen error branches (FEAT-002) bound every targeted screen.
Do NOT weaken security: keep Bearer auth, keep the refresh token in SecureStore, keep X-Client: mobile. Do NOT touch tracking or rider flow.
acceptance_criteria: Changing an order status in app/admin/order/[id].tsx updates the UI immediately and the status button does not spin waiting on the network; a failed call rolls the status back and shows an error toast.
src/api.ts: a 401 refresh happens at most once per request and a failing refresh does not loop; a hard refresh failure surfaces as a thrown ApiError, not an unresolved promise.
No security regression: Bearer header, SecureStore refresh token, and X-Client: mobile are all still present; no AbortController or setOnSessionExpired was invented.
Running `npm run typecheck` yields no new TypeScript errors beyond the known app.config.ts one.
verification: From the mobile dir run `npm run typecheck` (after FEAT-001's npm install) and confirm no new errors.
Read-through: setStatus is optimistic with rollback; the api.ts 401 path is single-shot and bounded; auth logout/bootstrap cannot strand the app on a spinner; Bearer/SecureStore/X-Client unchanged.
findings: setStatus() in app/admin/order/[id].tsx is now optimistic with rollback: it snapshots prevOrder (['order', o.order_id]) and prevAll (['all-orders']), writes the new order_status to both caches immediately, then fires api.post('/admin/orders/status',...) in the background (no awaited spinner). On success it invalidates ['order', o.order_id] + ['all-orders'] as before; on failure it restores both snapshots via qc.setQueryData and shows showToast(apiError(e),'error'). Removed the now-redundant `saving` useState and the Button `loading` prop (selected state still shown via outline={o.order_status !== st}); dropped the unused useState import; added `import type { Order }`. Added the required comment noting this is the 'order staff ke delete pe loader' surface and that NO DELETE endpoint exists in the mobile app. AUDIT (no behavior change — both already correct): src/api.ts 401 path is single-shot and bounded — isAuthCall excludes /users/login,/users/refresh,/users/register; opts._retried guards exactly one refresh+retry so it cannot loop; refreshSession() is single-flight via the shared `refreshing` promise; a failed refresh falls through and throws an ApiError (never an unresolved promise). src/store/auth.ts logout is local-first (clearRefreshToken + setAccessToken(null) + set({user:null}) always run even if network calls fail) and bootstrap() sets ready in finally so a failed/offline refresh never strands the splash. Added documenting comments to all three audited blocks. No security regression: Bearer header, SecureStore refresh token, and X-Client:mobile unchanged; no AbortController/timeout or setOnSessionExpired invented. Tracking and rider flow untouched. `npm run typecheck`: only the known pre-existing app.config.ts usesCleartextTraffic error (TS2353) remains — no new errors.
